# BLO-32843 — publish a `cheap` model profile so recovery/review runs actually downgrade

`src/index.ts` exports `modelProfiles` and `src/server/index.ts` returns it from
`createServerAdapter()`. Without it the server's `listAdapterModelProfiles("opencode_k8s")`
returned `[]`, `resolveModelProfileApplication` fell back with
`adapter_profile_not_supported`, and every run requesting `cheap` (stranded-issue
recovery, productivity review) was write-restricted as cheap while launching on the
agent's primary model. Measured live 2026-10-21: `GET …/adapters/opencode_k8s/model-profiles`
→ `[]` against `claude_local` → `[cheap]` as the positive control.

Cheap = `openai/gpt-6-luna` `variant: low`, overridable by `PAPERCLIP_OPENCODE_CHEAP_MODEL` (same knob as opencode_local). An agent on another provider should pin `runtimeConfig.modelProfiles.cheap`.

`src/server/model-profiles.test.ts` asserts the profile is published and names a model
this adapter lists; verified by mutation (dropping it from `createServerAdapter()`
fails the test).
